name: @taste-and-see/nest-pagerduty
description: Shared PagerDuty Events API v2 client for the Taste & See platform. Best-effort, never-throws on-call paging behind a `PagerDutyModule.forRoot({ source })` dynamic module — the durable domain record is always the source of truth and a paging failure never rolls it back. No SDK: the enqueue endpoint is a plain authenticated HTTPS POST, so this adds no approved-library dependency (CLAUDE.md §13). Extracted from service-concierge's TS-225 client so the trust-safety welfare escalation path (TS-302d) pages on-call without forking it. TS-302b.
